observations.code_quote: - `DefaultTooltip` (the built-in tooltip, also usable from a custom `tooltip` render prop) takes optional `valueFormatter`, `labelFormatter`, `labelRenderer`, `showHeader`, `showTotal`, `totalLabel`, `totalFormatter`, `sortedByValue`, `hideZeroRows`, `onRowClick`, and `footer`. `valueFormatter` gets `(value, entry)` — the row's `seriesData` entry as a second arg — so each row can format with its own `series.meta` (e.g. per-column currency/duration); it may return a node, not just a string (e.g. a property-formatted value). `labelFormatter` transforms the raw x-axis label shown in the tooltip header (e.g. convert an ISO datetime string to "Jun 24, 10:00"); on time-series charts with `xAxis.timezone` + `interval` set it defaults to an interval-aware date formatter that includes the weekday for single-day buckets ("Sat, Jun 6, 2026", "Sat, Jun 6, 14:00"; week/month buckets span days, so "Jun 1, 2026", "Jun 2026"), so the header matches the auto-formatted axis ticks — an explicit `labelFormatter` still wins. `labelRenderer` overrides how each row's label renders (defaults to the series label) — use for richer labels than a plain string, e.g. breakdown-value pills. `showHeader` (default true) toggles the header label row — pass false for charts without a meaningful header (pie slices, aggregated single-column bars). `showTotal` appends a footer row summing the visible series; it excludes `overlay` series (goal lines) and series with `visibility.total: false` (values that don't sum meaningfully with the rest, e.g. a percentage column alongside counts — the row itself still renders) from the sum, and is suppressed when fewer than two summable series remain. `totalFormatter` formats the total (defaults to `valueFormatter` applied with the first summable row's entry); `totalLabel` defaults to `'Total'`. `sortedByValue` sorts rows by value descending so the highest value appears first. `hideZeroRows` drops rows whose value is exactly `0` (e.g. lifecycle statuses absent for a period), so the tooltip lists only series with data at the hovered point. `onRowClick` makes each series row clickable (firing with the row's `seriesData` entry) — the tooltip must be pinned for clicks to land, since an unpinned tooltip is `pointer-events: none`; use it to open a per-series drill-down (e.g. the persons modal). `footer` renders arbitrary content below all rows (with a divider) — useful for "click to inspect" hints. A formatter taking only `value` stays compatible — the extra arg is ignored. Pinned tooltips are copy-friendly: outside-dismissal keys off where the press _started_ (pointer-down outside the tooltip/chart, or Escape), so a text-selection drag that releases outside the tooltip doesn't dismiss it, and a click that completes a text selection inside a row doesn't fire `onRowClick`.
